final_message:
Your March 10 revision (v4) is ready for Dr. Weiss’s regrade. You lead with the one-year fare-free trial on routes 14 and 22, and both comma splices are fixed. I marked all four comments about those changes as addressed.

You’ll need to resubmit v4 yourself by Friday, March 12 at 11:59 p.m. Eastern. The March 7 draft is still the version on file.

I also saved a checklist for the final essay. The two biggest remaining questions are how much Riverton’s ridership rose, according to which source, and how the city would pay for the trial.
